INSERT INTO video_renditions(id,photo_id,codec,hash,width,height,bytes,duration_ms)
              SELECT gen_random_uuid(),p.id,v.codec,$1,CASE WHEN v.codec='h264' THEN 1080 ELSE 1920 END,CASE WHEN v.codec='h264' THEN 608 ELSE 1080 END,1000,1200
              FROM photos p CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('av1'),('h264')) v(codec) WHERE p.kind='video'
